releaseNotes:
### Fixed
- **Long-range Usage windows are cached** — 7d/30d/60d/all stats aggregate from raw history through a watermark-advanced window cache instead of re-reading the daily rollup on every poll; a 50k-row ledger drops from 100-480ms cold folds to roughly 10-20ms cached reads.
- **The daily chart, burn rate, cache-hit totals, Details count, prompt-cache and compression analytics** now serve repeated dashboard reads from cached, watermark-advanced aggregates. Unknown periods fall back to 24h on both resolvers, and daily breakdowns carry LastUsed timestamps.
- **The Overview slows to 15s/60s polls on long ranges** and caps breakdown tables at 200 rendered rows with a Show more control; short windows keep the fast schedules.
